title: Versioned immutable execution-authority snapshot — CANDIDATE v0.1.1-r2 (not frozen, not active, grants nothing)
description: PR363 §7.4 step-2 candidate, revision r2 per merged root review. One minimal shape for a versioned immutable authority snapshot. Field names, grammars and semantics of the six current_contract fields are carried over UNCHANGED from scripts/ci-pr-gate.mjs checkCurrentContract at fixed master 4aaaa7b2af87f80a0fae62d9c8d9cf03d5a6fd84 (Q2 grammar :325-330, Q4 baseline :333-336); this schema validates SHAPE only. Every external reality check the legacy block gets today must keep running against the snapshot after any switch: active_plan/backlog/matrix target existence (Q2 fileExists), baseline resolves AND is HEAD-or-ancestor (Q4 revExists/baselineCurrent — git object reality, never a copy), backlog BL-/BR id population (GROUP C ci-pr-gate.mjs:351-356), matrix row contract (Q5 :372-406), phase-baseline-ref lines (Q6 :485-492), and the second independent awk reader at .github/workflows/census-runtime.yml:129. Those are publisher/CI duties, not schema duties; dropping any of them at switch time is a regression, not a simplification.

Candidate names follow the existing kebab-case scripts/ convention (docs-sync.mjs, doc-checks.mjs, gen-current-state.mjs, census yml): publisher command candidate scripts/publish-authority.mjs. x-carriers.current_pointer: dev/engineering/current-authority.json — standalone file carrying exactly {snapshot_version, content_digest}

snapshot_version.description: Explicit version id (asYYYYMMDDrN). Immutability is a publisher rule for PUBLISHED snapshots — the schema can only name it. Candidate drafts are NOT version claims and may coexist freely; nothing here forbids parallel candidate files, branches or authors (root ruling 1).

supersedes.description: The single immediately-preceding PUBLISHED version this snapshot is presented to succeed, or null for the first. Lineage metadata on one candidate: multiple candidates may each name a parent and coexist unjudged (no fork rule at the snapshot layer). Competition is decided solely at the live pointer — see PUBLISHER-CONTRACT r2 §1/§5.

authored_from.description: Parent-version / source ANCHOR only: where lineage can be re-derived and checked later. It is NOT the source of the six values — the new values come from the author's explicit draft (root ruling 3); the anchor records provenance of derivation, e.g. graph block at a named commit or a prior snapshot at a named commit.

published_by.description: Producer provenance metadata, recorded as named: who produced this published snapshot. It carries NO uniqueness or identity rule (root ruling 1): the single-write-entry property lives exclusively at the live pointer (one pointer file, one update per transaction), not in this field and not in any identity law.

published_utc.description: Publication wall-clock, included in content_digest like every other key (root ruling 4; r1's future-hash-exclusion speculation removed).

current_phase_statement.description: OPTIONAL carrier for the adjacent live statement graph.yaml:64 current_phase. NOT a seventh current_contract field and NOT a synonym of phase_id: its graded relationship to phase_id is a digit-agreement check (ci-pr-gate.mjs:343-345: pm=/^alpha(\d+)/i.exec(phase_id); the statement must contain ALPHA\.?<N>) plus the Alpha.4 ban (:343) and the state-freshness bans (:186-195: must not embed a revision, must not enumerate PR numbers). The digit cross-check is cross-field and therefore a publisher-side check, not expressible in this draft-07 shape; the two machine-bannable shapes are pinned below. Whether current_phase is retired or restated at switch time is §7.4 step-6 adjudication (AUTHORITY-MIGRATION-MAP adjacent_live_statement), still open.

current_contract.description: Exactly the six fields, same names, same original semantics (AUTHORITY-MIGRATION-MAP old_current_contract_fields). No additions: an unknown seventh key is exactly the silent drift Q3 counts against today.

phase_id.description: Grammar copied verbatim from ci-pr-gate.mjs:326. Sole downstream machine consumer of its value today is doc-checks checkPlanCitationBlocks via the derived mirror (MACHINE-CONSUMERS MC-04).

active_plan.description: Prefix check per Q2 (:328-330); target existence is a publisher/CI duty.

backlog.description: A single non-space path. Not a leaf pointer: its content authorises graph ready:/blocked: BL-/BR ids (GROUP C ci-pr-gate.mjs:351-356) and Q6 re-reads its phase-baseline-ref line (:485-492); the content contract travels with the value.

matrix.description: A single non-space path. Not a leaf pointer: Q5 grades the file itself (boundary markers, region order, 9-cell rows, positive-claim set, ci-pr-gate.mjs:372-406).

baseline.description: Exactly 40 hex per Q4 (:333). The value's MEANING lives in git object reality (must resolve; HEAD or ancestor; equality with HEAD legal) — the snapshot records the string, git decides it. census-runtime.yml:129 is a second independent reader and must be repointed in any switch transaction.

baseline_collected.description: ISO8601Z per Q2 (:330). Timestamp only; no external corroboration exists (MIGRATION-MAP field note).

content_digest.description: The authority digest every parallel Agent must explicitly bind to during the switch window (§7.4 fixed order, last sentence). Computed per x-status.digest_algorithm_reused over this object with content_digest itself removed; the live pointer file records snapshot_version + this digest as its two keys.
